shortDesc: Interactive browser simulation of electric charge distribution and field line visualisation.
fullDesc:
An interactive 2D physics engine built to simulate and visual electrostatic field layouts.

Core Idea:
Users place positive and negative point charges on a canvas, and the simulation computes the net electrostatic potential at every pixel using Coulomb's law. Rather than showing static images, it traces field lines in real-time starting near the boundaries of positive charges and stepping through space using numerical integration (Euler's method) until they reach a negative charge or exit the viewport. It also renders a dynamic scalar gradient field showing spatial voltage distribution.
highlights: Real-time 2D electrostatic potential rendering using HTML Canvas
Dynamic field line tracing via numerical integration (Euler's method)
Interactive controls for charge value adjustment and location manipulation
Vector field representation with vector arrows or density mapping
